items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Hale was one of his shadows... I had a chance to teach Ted Hale how to tap dance... he was originally under contract with Ted Lewis

ctx.x: How were they relating to tap dance? What was their connection?

Well, there's a for instance. You take like Teddy Hale. He used to be the shadow of -- one of the shadows of Ted Lewis, that made that song famous about me and my shadow walking up the avenue. Teddy Hale was one of his shadows. But after they grow, become a certain age, Mr. Ted Lewis didn't have -- he'd get a new shadow, however that's possible. Now, I had a chance to teach Ted Hale how to tap dance. See? And that's where I used to go with him. Until I thought that he remembered everything that he was learning.…
